title: Every Cyberpunk TCG card, your collection and tournaments near you
lead: TCG Tracker brings together the full Cyberpunk TCG card list, collection and value tracking, deck building, and a directory of tournaments and game stores. Free, no ads.
findBody: Tournaments announced by stores and players, and the stores that keep the game alive.

features.title: Collection tracking
features.body: Add your cards in a few clicks, even whole ranges at once, and see what your collection is worth.
points: Condition and purchase price of every copy
Value at Cardmarket prices, and how it moves
CSV import and share your binder with a link

features.title: Deck building
features.body: Build your decks: the app checks the deckbuilding rules for you.
points: 3 Legends, 40 to 50 cards, 3 copies at most
RAM limit per color worked out for you
The cards you're missing and what they cost

features.title: Tournaments
features.body: Find a tournament near you, or run your own at a store or with friends.
points: Sign up in one click or with a code
Swiss rounds in Bo1 or Bo3, round timer

features.title: Full card list
features.body: Every card in the game, with its text, printings and market price.
points: Cost, power, RAM and rules text

features.title: Game stores
features.body: The stores that keep the game alive, and their next events.

features.title: Learn to play
features.body: A real guided game against a Rival, move by move, then the full rules.
points: Playmat zones and how to read a card

finalBody: Create a free account and find your cards on all your devices, even offline.

showcase.win: 7 Gigs at the start of your turn: you win
